idea-plugin.name: Keystroke Quest
idea-plugin.description:
Turn every keystroke into a celebration. Keystroke Quest adds explosive visual effects, synthesized sound and an XP / leveling system to your editor.

  • Effects: blips with character labels, booms when deleting, newline streaks, screen shake, caret trail, and fireworks on level-up.
  • Combo streak: type fast to build a combo that scales effects and bonus XP.
  • Themes and sound packs: Neon, Retro 8-bit, Minimal and Sad. All sounds are synthesized at runtime, so there are no audio files to download.
  • IDE events: confetti when a run passes, a red flash when it fails, fireworks on commit, sparkles on refactorings and when a file becomes warning-free, and a flash on breakpoint hits.
  • Progression: XP, levels and titles, daily quests, achievements, daily streaks and a shareable stats card.
  • Cats: every level unlocks a unique virtual cat that roams your IDE and can be petted.
  • Wellbeing: optional break reminders.
  • Accessibility: reduced-effects mode turns off visuals, sound and shake while XP keeps counting.

Open Settings | Tools | Keystroke Quest to tune everything, or use the Keystroke Quest tool window.

Inspired by the VS Code extension "Ridiculous Coding", the Godot plugin "ridiculous_coding" by John Watson, and Textreme2 by Ash K.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.3
  • Trophy XP rewards are halved.
1.3.2
  • 11 new cat trophies: cat collection milestones, Nine Lives, petting totals, best friends, and petting every cat.
1.3.1
  • Petting a cat now produces hearts only when the pet counts, and a cat can be petted once a second.
1.3.0
  • Renamed to Keystroke Quest.
  • Sitting cats: the tail now rests on the ground, and collars and scarves wrap across the neck instead of sticking out at an angle.
1.2.2
  • "Reset XP" is now "Reset Progress" and clears everything earned: level, XP, cats, trophies, stats and quests. Settings are kept.
1.2.1
  • Reset XP now also removes your cats.
  • The "Hello, World" trophy now pays 10 XP.
1.2.0
  • Every level now rewards you with a new, unique virtual cat that walks along your IDE panels, jumps between them, grooms and naps. Click a cat to pet it (+1 XP, hearts).
  • Cats can be switched off, or limited to fewer on screen, for performance.
1.1.0
  • Trophies now pay 100-1000 XP, always more than a daily quest (30-40 XP).
  • Daily quests now roll over at midnight without restarting the IDE.
1.0.0
  • Initial release: effects, sound, XP and levels, combo, themes, quests, achievements, run / commit / debugger / refactoring events, stats card export, break reminders.
